-- ── Commands a button can hold, and the radial menu's entries ── BENILLA_MOBILE_COMMANDS = { { key = "target", label = "Target", icon = "Interface\\Icons\\Ability_Hunter_SniperShot", run = function() TargetNearestEnemy() end }, { key = "chat", label = "Chat", icon = "Interface\\Icons\\INV_Letter_01", run = function() ChatFrame_OpenChat("") end }, { key = "autorun", label = "Autorun", icon = "Interface\\Icons\\Ability_Rogue_Sprint", run = function() ToggleAutoRun() end }, { key = "sit", label = "Sit", icon = "Interface\\Icons\\Spell_Nature_Sleep", run = function() SitOrStand() end }, { key = "assist", label = "Assist", icon = "Interface\\Icons\\Ability_Warrior_BattleShout", run = function() AssistUnit("target") end }, { key = "follow", label = "Follow", icon = "Interface\\Icons\\INV_Misc_Spyglass_02", run = function() FollowUnit("target") end }, { key = "friend", label = "Target Friend", icon = "Interface\\Icons\\Spell_Holy_PowerInfusion", run = function() TargetNearestFriend() end }, { key = "character", label = "Character", icon = "Interface\\Icons\\INV_Chest_Cloth_17", run = function() ToggleCharacter("PaperDollFrame") end }, { key = "spells", label = "Spellbook", icon = "Interface\\Icons\\INV_Misc_Book_09", run = function() ToggleSpellBook(BOOKTYPE_SPELL) end }, { key = "talents", label = "Talents", icon = "Interface\\Icons\\Ability_Marksmanship", run = function() ToggleTalentFrame() end }, { key = "quests", label = "Quests", icon = "Interface\\Icons\\INV_Misc_Note_01", run = function() ToggleQuestLog() end }, { key = "social", label = "Social", icon = "Interface\\Icons\\INV_Misc_Head_Human_01", run = function() ToggleFriendsFrame() end }, { key = "map", label = "Map", icon = "Interface\\Icons\\INV_Misc_Map_01", run = function() ToggleWorldMap() end }, { key = "bags", label = "Bags", icon = "Interface\\Icons\\INV_Misc_Bag_08", run = function() OpenAllBags() end }, { key = "menu", label = "Game Menu", icon = "Interface\\Icons\\INV_Misc_Gear_01", run = function() ToggleGameMenu() end }, } BENILLA_MOBILE_COMMAND = {} for _, c in ipairs(BENILLA_MOBILE_COMMANDS) do BENILLA_MOBILE_COMMAND[c.key] = c end
-- The radial menu: the windows first, then the rest. BENILLA_MOBILE_RADIAL = { "character", "spells", "talents", "quests", "social", "map", "bags", "chat", "target", "menu" }
-- ── Elements: what the editor moves. Positions are a centre as a share of the screen, -- kept 60 points in from the side edges, clear of the camera housing in either landscape ── BENILLA_MOBILE_ELEMENTS = { { id = "ring", frame = "BenillaMobileRing", label = "Jump Ring", x = 0.87, y = 0.2, scale = 1 }, { id = "menu", frame = "BenillaMobileMenuButton", label = "Menu", x = 0.935, y = 0.64, scale = 1 }, { id = "button1", frame = "BenillaMobileButton1", label = "Button 1", x = 0.935, y = 0.52, scale = 1, action = "target" }, { id = "button2", frame = "BenillaMobileButton2", label = "Button 2", x = 0.935, y = 0.40, scale = 1, action = "chat" }, { id = "button3", frame = "BenillaMobileButton3", label = "Button 3", x = 0.065, y = 0.64, scale = 1, action = "autorun", hidden = 1 }, }
-- What each view shows: the jump ring's slots are their own entry. BENILLA_MOBILE_VIEWS = { combat = { ring = 1, slots = 1, menu = 1, button1 = 1, button2 = 1, button3 = 1 }, explore = { ring = 1, menu = 1, button2 = 1, button3 = 1 }, social = { ring = 1, menu = 1, button2 = 1 }, minimal = { menu = 1 }, } BENILLA_MOBILE_VIEW_ORDER = { "combat", "explore", "social", "minimal" } BENILLA_MOBILE_VIEW_LABEL = { combat = "Combat", explore = "Explore", social = "Social", minimal = "Minimal" }
BenillaMobile = { layout = {}, editing = nil, selected = nil, seen = {} }
function BenillaMobile_Element(id) for _, e in ipairs(BENILLA_MOBILE_ELEMENTS) do if e.id == id then return e end end end
-- The layout: the element's default, with what mobileLayout says on top. function BenillaMobile_Get(id) local e = BenillaMobile_Element(id) local l = BenillaMobile.layout[id] or {} local hidden = e.hidden if l.hidden ~= nil then hidden = l.hidden end return l.x or e.x, l.y or e.y, l.scale or e.scale, hidden, l.action or e.action end
-- "id=x,y,scale,hidden,action;..." function BenillaMobileLayout_Parse(text) local layout = {} for id, x, y, scale, hidden, action in string.gfind(text or "", "([%w]+)=([%d%.%-]+),([%d%.%-]+),([%d%.]+),([01]),([%w]*);") do local h = nil if hidden == "1" then h = 1 end if hidden == "0" then h = 0 end if action == "" then action = nil end layout[id] = { x = tonumber(x), y = tonumber(y), scale = tonumber(scale), hidden = h, action = action } end return layout end
function BenillaMobileLayout_Serialize() local out = "" for _, e in ipairs(BENILLA_MOBILE_ELEMENTS) do local x, y, scale, hidden, action = BenillaMobile_Get(e.id) local h = "0" if hidden and hidden ~= 0 then h = "1" end out = out .. string.format("%s=%.4f,%.4f,%.2f,%s,%s;", e.id, x, y, scale, h, action or "") end return out end
function BenillaMobileLayout_Save() SetCVar("mobileLayout", BenillaMobileLayout_Serialize()) BenillaMobile.seen.layout = GetCVar("mobileLayout") end
function BenillaMobile_IsHidden(hidden) return hidden and hidden ~= 0 end
-- Place, size, show and label every element for the layout and the view. function BenillaMobile_Apply() -- A controller plays instead: the touch controls step aside while one is connected. local on = GetCVar("mobileTouchControls") ~= "0" and not BENILLA_PAD_CONNECTED local view = BENILLA_MOBILE_VIEWS[GetCVar("mobileView") or "combat"] or BENILLA_MOBILE_VIEWS.combat local alpha = BenillaMobile_Alpha() -- GetScreenWidth: the UIParent units its children are placed in, under any UI scale. local w, h = GetScreenWidth(), GetScreenHeight() for _, e in ipairs(BENILLA_MOBILE_ELEMENTS) do local f = getglobal(e.frame) local x, y, scale, hidden, action = BenillaMobile_Get(e.id) f:SetScale(scale) f:ClearAllPoints() f:SetPoint("CENTER", UIParent, "BOTTOMLEFT", x * w / scale, y * h / scale) if f.SetCommand then f:SetCommand(action) end local shown = on and view[e.id] and not BenillaMobile_IsHidden(hidden) if BenillaMobile.editing then f:Show() if BenillaMobile_IsHidden(hidden) then f:SetAlpha(0.35) else f:SetAlpha(1) end elseif shown then f:SetAlpha(alpha) f:Show() else f:Hide() end end local slots = BenillaMobile.editing or view.slots for k = 1, 8 do local s = getglobal("BenillaMobileRingSlot" .. k) if slots then s:Show() else s:Hide() end end end
-- Idle, the controls fade to mobileControlsAlpha; a finger on the screen (the touch layer -- moves the cursor where it lands) brings them back for a few seconds. BENILLA_MOBILE_AWAKE_SECS = 4 function BenillaMobile_Alpha() local idle = tonumber(GetCVar("mobileControlsAlpha") or "") or 0.4 if BenillaMobile.awakeUntil and GetTime() < BenillaMobile.awakeUntil then return 1 end return idle end
function BenillaMobile_Wake() local x, y = GetCursorPosition() local moved = x ~= BenillaMobile.cursorX or y ~= BenillaMobile.cursorY BenillaMobile.cursorX, BenillaMobile.cursorY = x, y local was = BenillaMobile_Alpha() if moved then BenillaMobile.awakeUntil = GetTime() + BENILLA_MOBILE_AWAKE_SECS end local now = BenillaMobile_Alpha() if now ~= was and not BenillaMobile.editing then for _, e in ipairs(BENILLA_MOBILE_ELEMENTS) do getglobal(e.frame):SetAlpha(now) end end end
-- The CVars the options page writes, read back each half second. function BenillaMobile_Poll() local changed = nil -- A resize or a new UI scale moves every element's share of the screen. local size = string.format("%.0fx%.0f", GetScreenWidth(), GetScreenHeight()) if BenillaMobile.seen.size ~= size then BenillaMobile.seen.size = size changed = 1 end if BenillaMobile.seen.pad ~= BENILLA_PAD_CONNECTED then BenillaMobile.seen.pad = BENILLA_PAD_CONNECTED changed = 1 end for _, name in ipairs({ "mobileView", "mobileTouchControls", "mobileControlsAlpha", "mobileLayout", "mobileRingBar" }) do local v = GetCVar(name) if BenillaMobile.seen[name] ~= v then BenillaMobile.seen[name] = v changed = 1 if name == "mobileLayout" then BenillaMobile.layout = BenillaMobileLayout_Parse(v) elseif name == "mobileRingBar" then BenillaMobileRing_UpdateAll() end end end if changed then BenillaMobile_Apply() end end
function BenillaMobile_SetView(view) SetCVar("mobileView", view) BenillaMobile_Poll() end
-- ── The jump ring ── -- Slot k shows action k of the bar mobileRingBar names; on the main bar it pages and -- follows the stance bar, as ActionButton1-12 and the bonus bar do. function BenillaMobileRing_ActionID(k) local bar = tonumber(GetCVar("mobileRingBar") or "") or 1 if bar == 1 then if CURRENT_ACTIONBAR_PAGE == 1 then local offset = GetBonusBarOffset() if offset and offset > 0 then return k + (NUM_ACTIONBAR_PAGES + offset - 1) * NUM_ACTIONBAR_BUTTONS end end return k + (CURRENT_ACTIONBAR_PAGE - 1) * NUM_ACTIONBAR_BUTTONS end return k + (bar - 1) * NUM_ACTIONBAR_BUTTONS end
local BenillaMobile_GetPagedID = ActionButton_GetPagedID function ActionButton_GetPagedID(button) if button.benillaSlot then return BenillaMobileRing_ActionID(button.benillaSlot) end return BenillaMobile_GetPagedID(button) end
function BenillaMobileRing_UpdateAll() local saved = this for k = 1, 8 do this = getglobal("BenillaMobileRingSlot" .. k) ActionButton_Update() end this = saved end
-- Four from straight up to straight left, then four further out between them: a slot -- is 49 units across at its scale, so neighbours sit 55 and 86 units apart. BENILLA_MOBILE_RING_SPOTS = { { 90, 105 }, { 120, 105 }, { 150, 105 }, { 180, 105 }, { 78, 168 }, { 106, 168 }, { 134, 168 }, { 162, 168 }, }
function BenillaMobileRingSlot_OnLoad() local k = this:GetID() this.benillaSlot = k -- UPDATE_BONUS_ACTIONBAR refreshes only an isBonus button. this.isBonus = 1 local spot = BENILLA_MOBILE_RING_SPOTS[k] local a = math.rad(spot[1]) this:SetScale(1.35) this:ClearAllPoints() this:SetPoint("CENTER", "BenillaMobileRingJump", "CENTER", math.cos(a) * spot[2] / 1.35, math.sin(a) * spot[2] / 1.35) ActionButton_OnLoad() end
-- ── Buttons that hold a command ── function BenillaMobileButton_SetCommand(button, key) local c = BENILLA_MOBILE_COMMAND[key or ""] or BENILLA_MOBILE_COMMAND.target button.command = c.key getglobal(button:GetName() .. "Icon"):SetTexture(c.icon) getglobal(button:GetName() .. "Label"):SetText(c.label) end
function BenillaMobileButton_OnClick() if BenillaMobile.editing then BenillaMobileLayout_Select(this.elementId) return end local c = BENILLA_MOBILE_COMMAND[this.command or ""] if c then c.run() end end
-- ── The radial menu ── function BenillaMobileRadial_Toggle() if BenillaMobileRadial:IsVisible() then BenillaMobileRadial:Hide() else BenillaMobileRadial:Show() end end
function BenillaMobileRadial_OnLoad() local n = table.getn(BENILLA_MOBILE_RADIAL) for i, key in ipairs(BENILLA_MOBILE_RADIAL) do local b = getglobal("BenillaMobileRadialEntry" .. i) local c = BENILLA_MOBILE_COMMAND[key] local a = math.rad(90 - (i - 1) * 360 / n) b:ClearAllPoints() b:SetPoint("CENTER", this, "CENTER", math.cos(a) * 230, math.sin(a) * 200) b.command = key getglobal(b:GetName() .. "Icon"):SetTexture(c.icon) getglobal(b:GetName() .. "Label"):SetText(c.label) end end
function BenillaMobileRadial_Run(key) BenillaMobileRadial:Hide() local c = BENILLA_MOBILE_COMMAND[key or ""] if c then c.run() end end
function BenillaMobileRadial_OnShow() local current = GetCVar("mobileView") or "combat" for i, v in ipairs(BENILLA_MOBILE_VIEW_ORDER) do local b = getglobal("BenillaMobileRadialView" .. i) b.view = v b:SetText(BENILLA_MOBILE_VIEW_LABEL[v]) if v == current then b:LockHighlight() else b:UnlockHighlight() end end end
-- ── The layout editor ── function BenillaMobileLayout_Toggle() if BenillaMobile.editing then BenillaMobileLayout_Done() else BenillaMobile.editing = 1 BenillaMobileRadial:Hide() BenillaMobileLayout_Select("ring") BenillaMobileEditor:Show() BenillaMobile_Apply() end end
function BenillaMobileLayout_Done() BenillaMobile.editing = nil BenillaMobileEditor:Hide() BenillaMobileLayout_Save() BenillaMobile_Apply() end
function BenillaMobileLayout_Select(id) BenillaMobile.selected = id local e = BenillaMobile_Element(id) local _, _, scale, hidden, action = BenillaMobile_Get(id) local text = e.label if action then text = text .. ": " .. BENILLA_MOBILE_COMMAND[action].label end BenillaMobileEditorSelected:SetText(text) if BenillaMobile_IsHidden(hidden) then BenillaMobileEditorHide:SetText("Show") else BenillaMobileEditorHide:SetText("Hide") end if action then BenillaMobileEditorAction:Enable() else BenillaMobileEditorAction:Disable() end if id == "ring" then BenillaMobileEditorBar:Enable() else BenillaMobileEditorBar:Disable() end end
function BenillaMobileLayout_Set(id, field, value) local l = BenillaMobile.layout[id] if not l then l = {} BenillaMobile.layout[id] = l end l[field] = value end
function BenillaMobileLayout_Scale(by) local id = BenillaMobile.selected if not id then return end local _, _, scale = BenillaMobile_Get(id) scale = math.max(0.5, math.min(2.5, scale + by)) BenillaMobileLayout_Set(id, "scale", scale) BenillaMobile_Apply() end
function BenillaMobileLayout_ToggleHidden() local id = BenillaMobile.selected if not id then return end local _, _, _, hidden = BenillaMobile_Get(id) if BenillaMobile_IsHidden(hidden) then BenillaMobileLayout_Set(id, "hidden", 0) else BenillaMobileLayout_Set(id, "hidden", 1) end BenillaMobileLayout_Select(id) BenillaMobile_Apply() end
-- The next command for a button, round the list. function BenillaMobileLayout_NextAction() local id = BenillaMobile.selected local _, _, _, _, action = BenillaMobile_Get(id or "") if not action then return end local n = table.getn(BENILLA_MOBILE_COMMANDS) for i, c in ipairs(BENILLA_MOBILE_COMMANDS) do if c.key == action then BenillaMobileLayout_Set(id, "action", BENILLA_MOBILE_COMMANDS[math.mod(i, n) + 1].key) break end end BenillaMobileLayout_Select(id) BenillaMobile_Apply() end
function BenillaMobileLayout_NextBar() local bar = tonumber(GetCVar("mobileRingBar") or "") or 1 SetCVar("mobileRingBar", tostring(math.mod(bar, 6) + 1)) BenillaMobile_Poll() BenillaMobileEditorBar:SetText("Bar " .. GetCVar("mobileRingBar")) end
function BenillaMobileLayout_StickSize(by) local v = tonumber(GetCVar("mobileStickSize") or "") or 1 SetCVar("mobileStickSize", string.format("%.2f", math.max(0.6, math.min(1.6, v + by)))) end
function BenillaMobileLayout_StickZone(by) local v = tonumber(GetCVar("mobileStickZone") or "") or 0.42 SetCVar("mobileStickZone", string.format("%.2f", math.max(0.25, math.min(0.6, v + by)))) end
function BenillaMobileLayout_Reset() BenillaMobile.layout = {} BenillaMobileLayout_Save() BenillaMobile_Apply() BenillaMobileLayout_Select(BenillaMobile.selected or "ring") end
-- An element under the finger in the editor moves with it. function BenillaMobileElement_OnMouseDown() if not BenillaMobile.editing then return end BenillaMobileLayout_Select(this.elementId) this:SetMovable(1) this:StartMoving() this.moving = 1 end
function BenillaMobileElement_OnMouseUp() if not this.moving then return end this.moving = nil this:StopMovingOrSizing() local x, y = this:GetCenter() local scale = this:GetScale() if x and y then BenillaMobileLayout_Set(this.elementId, "x", x * scale / GetScreenWidth()) BenillaMobileLayout_Set(this.elementId, "y", y * scale / GetScreenHeight()) end BenillaMobile_Apply() end

Scripts.OnEvent: if event == "UPDATE_BONUS_ACTIONBAR" then BenillaMobileRing_UpdateAll() else BenillaMobile.seen = {} BenillaMobile_Poll() end
Scripts.OnUpdate: -- The screen every frame (a resize must not wait), the CVars twice a second. BenillaMobile_Wake() local w, h = GetScreenWidth(), GetScreenHeight() this.elapsed = this.elapsed + arg1 if this.elapsed > 0.5 or w ~= this.w or h ~= this.h then this.elapsed = 0 this.w, this.h = w, h BenillaMobile_Poll() end

Scripts.OnClick: if BenillaMobile.editing then BenillaMobileLayout_Select("ring") else Jump() end
Scripts.OnMouseDown: if BenillaMobile.editing then this:GetParent().elementId = "ring" local saved = this this = this:GetParent() BenillaMobileElement_OnMouseDown() this = saved end
Scripts.OnMouseUp: local saved = this this = this:GetParent() BenillaMobileElement_OnMouseUp() this = saved

Scripts.OnClick: if BenillaMobile.editing then BenillaMobileLayout_Select("menu") else BenillaMobileRadial_Toggle() end

FontString.text: Edit Layout: drag a control to move it, tap it to choose it. Drag a spell onto a ring slot to change it.
